text: おれは　おとな　だから　がっつかないのさ　レッドから　さきに　えらばせて　やるぜ！

structure.jp: おれは　おとな　だから

structure.en: I don't get greedy, you see

structure.jp: レッドから　さきに
えらばせて　やるぜ！

patterns.name: 〜させてやる
patterns.explanation: The せ form of a verb means letting someone do it, and やる adds that you do this as a favour from above. えらばせて　やる = 'I'll let you choose'.

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after だ or a verb gives the reason for what comes next. おとな　だから = 'because I'm a grown-up'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end gives the feel of explaining how things are; さ in place of だ is a cool, casual male touch. がっつかないのさ = 'I don't get greedy, see'.
